findings.title: Load fallback translations outside the controller request path too
findings.body: Fallback locale files are loaded only by this controller filter, but the translation accelerator deliberately disables automatic loading and loads only the current locale in I18n.translate. Translations performed outside controller requests (for example, mailers and background jobs in a separate worker process) therefore search fallback locales whose YAML files have never been loaded. Missing localized keys will still produce missing-translation results even when the site language or English contains them. Ensure the fallback chain is loaded as part of translation lookup rather than relying on a request filter.

findings.title: Include the site fallback locale in the translation cache context
findings.body: The fallback result now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the accelerator caches argument-free translations using only the key, current locale, and backend object ID. If the site default language changes while a user's locale stays the same, a key missing in that user's language continues returning the previously cached fallback text instead of the new site-language translation. On a shared backend this also allows sites with different defaults to reuse each other's fallback results. Include the fallback context in the cache key or invalidate the cache when that context changes.
